summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by foreign private issuer Black Titan Corp, reporting unaudited financial results for the six months ended January 31, 2026. It also provides background on the company's formation to facilitate a merger between TTNP and TalenTec, which closed on October 1, 2025. The filing contains forward-looking statements and risk factors. No special-situation event is announced. The financial results and narrative are routine operational updates. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or management change. Thus, the filing does not constitute a special situation.
